_metadata.description: One-touch per-OS bootstrap that installs Vrooli + node-agent and pairs out-of-band; mutual auth; atomic revocation.

requirements.title: One-Touch Bootstrap & Mutual Auth
requirements.description: A single bootstrap command run once on a new machine installs Vrooli, runs setup, installs the node-agent as an OS service, and pairs to the control plane via an out-of-band single-use code/token. Node and control plane mutually authenticate every exchange; revoking a node atomically kills both its job and provisioning rights.

validation.notes: Single-use short-TTL pairing token issues a mutual-auth credential; reuse and expiry are rejected.
Node→control-plane mutual auth: a valid signed proof verifies; unknown/revoked node, cross-node replay, stale timestamp, and tampered signatures are all rejected.
Control-plane→node identity: a stable persisted Ed25519 key (owner-only seed) signs pushes a node can verify against the pinned public key (rejects an impostor coordinator).
Atomic revocation: a single RevokeNode revokes the durable record AND severs the mutual-auth credential AND drops the live channel in one operation.
Live enforcement: with the verifier wired, an unsigned or impostor-signed heartbeat is rejected; a validly-signed one is accepted.
Agent signing: the node keypair is stable + owner-only and its signatures match the canonical nodeauth wire format (cross-module contract).
Fresh-machine acceptance: one bootstrap invocation yields a paired, mutually-authenticated, online node. The per-OS service-install step (systemd/launchd/Windows Service) lands in Phase 4.
